result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and written certification of deletion. It preserves the existing termination and payment provisions. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring transfer of Site/URL access credentials, which may implicate ownership or security issues and is not necessary to satisfy the rule. Drafting is generally professional, but the deadlines are tied to the defined “Termination Date” even though the provision also applies upon expiration, when that term may not apply; the credentials “relating to ... the URL” language is also imprecise.
